clues.text: Wise men from the east opened their treasures in Bethlehem and gave this to the Child.
Nicodemus brought about seventy-five pounds of this, mixed with aloes, to prepare the body of Jesus.
At Golgotha, soldiers offered Jesus wine mixed with this, but He did not take it.
The Ishmaelite caravan that came by as Joseph sat in the pit carried this down to Egypt.
Jacob had his sons carry this, with balm, honey and nuts, as a gift for the ruler in Egypt.
God told Moses to use 500 shekels of it in liquid form for the sacred anointing oil.
Before going to King Xerxes, each young woman had six months of beauty treatments with oil of this.
